content.summary: An ice observatory resolves into one dormant machine around a surveyor. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One human scale anchor remains readable. + Environmental pieces approach before the larger interpretation appears. + Activation follows visible floor or structure cues. + The camera preserves platform geography through the reveal. + The final giant structure contains rather than replaces the opening space.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one circular ice observatory above a clouded moon with a single adult surveyor at its center. Push closer without changing the surveyor's white suit, red backpack and central position. Pull wide to reveal the observatory as the eye region of a dormant machine while the same surveyor remains the human scale mark.

invariants.rule: One human scale anchor remains readable.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.

invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.

invariants.rule: Activation follows visible floor or structure cues.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Activation follows visible floor or structure cues."

invariants.rule: The camera preserves platform geography through the reveal.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The camera preserves platform geography through the reveal."

invariants.rule: The final giant structure contains rather than replaces the opening space.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final giant structure contains rather than replaces the opening space."
